confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Tokyo food and drink prices. The RBA rate is the 18 Nov 2026 observation of 0.6720 USD per AUD, from the RBA exchange-rate pages. Food and drink figures come from Numbeo data (June 2026) republished by Expatica, in yen: inexpensive meal about ¥1,200, three-course meal for two about ¥7,010, cappuccino about ¥534, and 0.5L draft beer about ¥550. I converted these to USD at an assumed rate of about 155 JPY per USD, which I did not check. No cocktail price or glass-of-wine price turned up for Tokyo. I set cocktail from the only figure found, a roughly $9 estimate from 2018 (an Aetna guide), plus general knowledge of Tokyo bar prices. I set wine by a typical ratio to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings, and they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Tokyo prices come from Tokyo-specific cost-of-living data, and accommodation reflects general knowledge of Tokyo's mix of capsule and hostel options, business hotels and a tourism-driven market.
